outputs.ff0t: F0 tremor frequency: the strongest slow modulation of the F0 contour, FF0T (Hz)
outputs.pf0t: F0 tremor prominence: depth of that modulation, PF0T (semitones)
outputs.fat: Amplitude tremor frequency: the strongest slow modulation of the envelope, FAT (Hz)
outputs.pat: Amplitude tremor prominence: depth of that modulation, PAT (%)

min_frequency.description: Lowest modulation frequency taken as tremor (Hz)

max_frequency.description: Highest modulation frequency taken as tremor (Hz)

stable_filter.description: 60 Hz high-pass before the amplitude tremor as second-order sections; False = transfer-function form as in the MATLAB original, which is numerically unstable at 48 kHz
